bio.en: Prof. Yuchuan Fan works on agricultural and environmental systems, with research interests spanning climate-smart agriculture, agricultural non-point source pollution control, soil health, agricultural water management, sustainable agroecosystems, ecological restoration, and global ecohydrology. His work connects process-based environmental research with modelling, intelligent sensing, and data-driven approaches to support the interpretation and management of agricultural-environmental challenges.
bio.zh: 范豫川教授长期从事农业与环境系统研究，研究兴趣涵盖气候智慧农业、农业面源污染治理、土壤健康、农水管理、农田生态系统可持续性、生态修复与全球生态水文等方向。他关注农业生产、资源环境与生态过程之间的联系，并致力于将过程研究、模型模拟、智能感知及数据分析方法用于农业环境问题的识别、解释与管理支持。

bio.en: Wei Fang received a Ph.D. in Agronomy in 2026 from the College of Environment and Resources and the College of Carbon Neutrality at Zhejiang A&F University. His research focuses on soil microorganism–plant interactions. He has participated in Zhejiang Province’s “Jianbing” and “Lingyan” R&D Key Programs and has published several papers in journals including Biology and Fertility of Soils, European Journal of Soil Biology, Frontiers in Microbiology, iMeta, and Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety. He is also the holder of two invention patents.
bio.zh: 方伟于2026年在浙江农林大学环境与资源学院、碳中和学院获农学博士学位。研究聚焦土壤微生物与植物互作。曾参与浙江省“尖兵”“领雁”研发攻关计划，在 Biology and Fertility of Soils、European Journal of Soil Biology、Frontiers in Microbiology、iMeta、Ecotoxicology and Environmental Safety 等期刊发表论文，并拥有两项发明专利。

bio.en: Jianxiao Su is a first-year PhD student focusing on plant functional traits, ecosystem productivity, and soil carbon cycling under global environmental change. She earned both a bachelor's degree in Biological Sciences and a master's degree in Botany from Xinjiang Normal University. Her research integrates field observations, large-scale ecological datasets, and statistical and machine learning approaches to examine ecological patterns and their underlying processes. She has published as a first author or co-first author in Journal of Environmental Management, Forest Ecology and Management, Forests, Forestry Research, and The Innovation Informatics. Her current research focuses on soil organic carbon dynamics, environmental drivers, and the application and interpretation of AI-based ecological models.
bio.zh: 苏建潇，浙江农林大学一年级博士研究生，研究方向为植物功能性状、生态系统生产力及全球变化背景下的土壤碳循环。本科与硕士毕业于新疆师范大学（生物科学学士、植物学硕士）。研究结合野外观测、大尺度生态数据以及统计与机器学习方法。曾以第一作者或共同第一作者在相关国际期刊发表论文。目前关注土壤有机碳动态、环境驱动因子及人工智能生态模型的应用与解释。

bio.en: Huang Tianhui is an incoming Master's student in Environmental Science and Engineering at Zhejiang A&F University. She holds a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and Automation from Hubei University of Technology. During her undergraduate studies, she completed core courses including Automatic Control Theory, Power Electronics, and Electrical Machinery. She is proficient in Matlab, AutoCAD, and Dev-C++. Additionally, she participated in projects such as intelligent car design and electrical assembly modeling. Her academic training provided a solid foundation in system modeling, data analysis, and electrical design.
bio.zh: 黄天荟，浙江农林大学环境科学与工程专业硕士研究生。本科毕业于湖北工业大学电气工程及其自动化专业，系统学习自动控制、电力电子与电机等课程，熟悉 Matlab、AutoCAD、Dev-C++，并参与智能车设计与电气装配建模等实践，具备系统建模与数据分析基础。

bio.en: Yan Haoyong is a first-year Master’s student at Zhejiang A&F University. He received his Bachelor’s degree in Data Science and Big Data Technology. His research interests include environmental remote sensing, intelligent image segmentation, big-data analysis and mathematical modeling. He is eager to apply data-driven methods to solve ecological and agricultural environmental problems, and keeps learning new tools for geospatial data processing.
bio.zh: 闫浩勇，浙江农林大学一年级硕士研究生。本科毕业于数据科学与大数据技术专业。研究兴趣包括环境遥感、智能图像分割、大数据分析与数学建模，致力于将数据驱动方法应用于生态与农业环境问题，并持续学习地理空间数据处理相关工具。

bio.en: Zhu Fengjun is a graduate student at Zhejiang A&F University, where he is engaged in study and research related to Human Geography and Urban-Rural Planning. He earned his bachelor’s degree in Human Geography and Urban-Rural Planning, which gave him a solid foundation in geography, urban-rural planning, and spatial analysis. During his undergraduate studies, he completed professional courses and became fairly proficient in CAD, C++, and ArcGIS. He can use these tools for mapping, data processing, spatial analysis, and basic programming.
bio.zh: 朱丰俊，浙江农林大学硕士研究生，从事人文地理与城乡规划相关学习与研究。本科毕业于人文地理与城乡规划专业，具备地理学、城乡规划与空间分析基础。本科阶段系统学习专业课程，较为熟练使用 CAD、C++ 与 ArcGIS，可用于制图、数据处理、空间分析及基础编程。

bio.en: Dr. Rui Jiang is a Lecturer in Environmental Engineering at the College of Biological and Environmental Sciences, College of Jiyang, Zhejiang A&F University. He received his PhD in June 2026 and joined the College in July 2026. His research focuses on soil biogeochemistry and the diagnosis and improvement of constraints in subtropical red soils. Current interests include soil carbon accumulation and compaction alleviation in red soils; mineral-microbial controls on soil organic carbon formation and stability; effects of tillage and crop management on soil carbon pools and structure; and iron-phosphorus interactions at mineral interfaces.
bio.zh: 江睿，博士，现为浙江农林大学暨阳学院生物与环境学院环境工程专业专任教师。2026 年 6 月获博士学位，同年 7 月加入暨阳学院。研究聚焦土壤生物地球化学与红壤障碍诊断及改良，重点关注红壤增碳与破板机制、矿物—微生物互作对土壤有机碳形成和稳定的调控、耕作管理对土壤碳库与结构的影响，以及土壤矿物界面铁—磷互作过程。
